blocks.description: Requests permission and connects a Sony PaSoRi reader over WebUSB with a project-local reader name.

blocks.text: wait for NFC card on PaSoRi [READER_ID] set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to IDm
blocks.description: Waits until a card is read on the named PaSoRi and stores its IDm in a runtime variable.

blocks.text: wait for NFC card on PaSoRi [READER_ID] set runtime var [RUNTIME_VAR] to IDm and broadcast [MESSAGE]
blocks.description: Waits until a card is read on the named PaSoRi, stores its IDm, and broadcasts a message.
Returns the most recent NFC IDm read by the named PaSoRi.
Returns the number of PaSoRi readers connected through this extension.
